variants.label: WLSMV
variants.model_syntax:
# =======================================
  # Reflective Measurement Model
  # =======================================
  # This is the theoretically grouped version 
  
  PowerPerc =~ bev_better_towing +
             bev_better_roughroad +
             bev_better_accel +
             bev_better_power
  
  NonPowerPerc =~ bev_better_comfort +
               bev_better_safety +
               bev_better_reliability

fornell_larcker.criterion: Both AVEs must exceed the squared latent correlation.
